content.rendered:
​Picture Day is Coming Soon!  Mark your calendars for September 30th.  Scan the QR code or visit mydorian.com, search for Middleton Elementary and click on the green order button or yellow help button associated with our picture day.

Picture packet order forms will be coming home September 19th, or you can order online now and for up to four (4) days after picture day. We will receive pictures about 30 days after our picture day. 

​
